summary: Claude Code changed the h1 from "Reports" to "Quarterly Reports" directly on the first turn, with no brainstorming skill invocation, no clarifying question, and no permission request.
reasoning: The request was a single local label edit; the agent treated it as rung 2 and acted immediately. Log evidence confirms no brainstorming skill, no question, no gating. Both criteria pass.

observations.description: The agent noted it left the <title> as 'Reports'. Reasonable and transparent given the literal request, though a user might consider title+heading one label. Not a defect.
Launch required stepping through four separate confirmation dialogs (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions), each defaulting to 'No, exit'. Minor friction for scripted/eval runs.
